kjv: the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ
mine: the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ
note: With one article governing "great God and Savior" (Granville Sharp's rule), the Greek most naturally calls Jesus Christ "our great God and Savior"; the KJV's "the great God and our Saviour" can be read as two persons. It also turns "the glory" into an adjective ("glorious").

mine: a people for his own possession
note: periousios is "treasured possession" (Exod 19:5 LXX); "peculiar" in 1611 meant "belonging to oneself", now it means "odd".
